positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Hacking on observability tools built for the enterprise. Focused on end-to-end web/DOM & API testing. Ruby & Rails, Python & Django, React & Next.js, Selenium, Docker & Kubernetes, Grafana, Victoria Metrics & Prometheus and whatever new tech tomorrow brings!

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Lead engineer for Enterprise Automic platform, a job scheduling and orchestration application (formerly known as UC4). Automic centralizes process management between heterogeneous environments, where a wide range of scheduled jobs can be viewed, complex workflows with various logic dependencies can be defined, and alerting can be configured for every step along the way.

Responsible for platform administration, developing new solutions, maintaining application at infrastructure level, etc. Platform currently leveraged by around 50 internal application teams, automating various jobs including SAP, OEBS, Oracle, MSSQL, Linux, Windows, Solaris, Big Data, FTP, the list goes on.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: During my time in this role, I transitioned from working alongside a team of engineers on the HPBAC monitoring suite, to the lead engineer of the Automic platform. Much learning; the occasional headache; boundless technical growth!

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description: Aid students in a variety of computer related tasks from Microsoft Office support, to help with debugging programming assignments. Management of computer resources and lab environments.

positions.title: Web Content Developer
positions.description: Joined Penn Tech's Career Services team to prototype, design and implement a website to support non-traditional by gender career seekers (males in nursing, females in construction).

positions.title: Web Design & Development Intern
positions.description: Emphasis on website development, from meeting with new clients for successful scope and requirements analysis, through to design, construction and implementation. Prominent use of Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator, for initial page mockups and branding for client approval. Emersion in the culture of a start-up company and exposure to key elements of success in today's IT market.

positions.title: Wall Panel Designer/Systems Admin
positions.description: Oversight of all on-site computer systems for more than 30 employees. Successfully worked with corporate office to implement new technologies. Additionally, performed residential and commercial CAD design of wall panel structures. Collaborated with other departments to facilitate proper design requirements, with sensitive time constraints. Performed supervisory checks of peer work, as well as frequent interaction with clients on and off site. Regularly called upon to train new hires both in house and from surrounding branches. Received designer of the year award in 2006, first qualifying year.

honors.title: 2010 Student Commencement Speaker
honors.description: I was elected Student Commencement Speaker for the winter 2010 graduating class.  Accepting the honor of speaking before a crowd of thousands did not come easily, but I am very grateful I did in the end.  A truly wonderful experience, and I owe many thanks to faculty and friends for their support.
honors.issuer: Issued by Pennsylvania College of Technology · Dec 2010

honors.title: 2006 Designer of the Year
honors.description: Received designer of the year award in 2006, first qualifying year.
honors.issuer: Issued by Universal Forest Products, New Windsor Maryland · Jan 2007
